_meta.description: ADK eval baseline for PawConscious Mesh — the verify_claim multi-agent flow. Each case is a real DTC pet supplement PDP URL. Pass criteria are structural: the mesh must return a signed PCEC bundle with the expected agent outputs populated. Run via tests/adk_eval/run.py against a live mesh-api revision. v0.2 = Day 21 R4 refresh — replaced dead URLs (live-checked 2026-05-21) and added a separate _synthetic_cases scoreboard for PDP-text-only fixtures.
_meta.agents_under_eval_note: report_writer (cert composition) and second_opinion (adversarial Google Search grounding) run after the signed bundle is returned; their outputs are not gated by the 4 structural assertions and are tested separately.
_meta.scoring: case PASSES if all 4 structural assertions pass against the 5 in-bundle agents; baseline target is 90% of cases. Cases with non-200 source URLs are SKIPPED at runtime (DTC catalogs churn) and excluded from the denominator. Anti-bot 4xx/5xx still serve a real page to Firecrawl; the runner relies on the mesh's fallback path.
_meta.last_url_check_method: GET via urllib with Mozilla UA over 8s timeout
_meta.synthetic_track_note: _synthetic_cases is a separate scoreboard for PDP-text-only fixtures. Never merged with the live-URL track. Reserved for Day 22+ runner support.
